title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Moderate thunderstorms are expected today

Highest Risk: SLGT (Southern Austria)

---Discussion---

There are two main areas of focus:

Bavaria and Southern Austria.

Isolated thunderstorms are forecast towards the night hours in Bavaria. Some models are showing mutliple, and some only 1 to 2 cells, but what are models most agreeing on is that they will be long tracked.

The more "concerning" area is in Southern Austria, where SLGT is was issued.

Multiple possible training thunderstorms, with plenty of CAPE available, will most likely bring Heavy rain with possible floods and possible big hail.
